decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to create repeated value and card advantage by utilizing flicker effects to return creatures like Mulldrifter and Sea Gate Oracle to the battlefield. By combining cards like Snap, Ephemerate, and Ghostly Flicker with Archaeomancer, the deck can consistently draw cards, control the board, and generate mana advantage. This combo-oriented strategy allows the deck to out-value opponents and overwhelm them with a steady stream of threats and answers. The inclusion of God-Pharaoh's Faithful and Prismatic Strands adds a layer of protection and lifegain to further solidify the deck's control game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By aggressively attacking and using direct damage spells, the deck aims to reduce the opponent's life total to zero as quickly as possible. The deck utilizes a mix of low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent plays each turn. Overall, the deck is designed for fast-paced, high-impact gameplay in Pauper 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal spells while also utilizing card draw and graveyard manipulation. With a mix of control elements like Counterspell and Agony Warp, along with efficient threats like Gurmag Angler, the goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and eventually win through attrition. The deck also includes cards like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour to draw cards and fill up the graveyard for value. Overall, the Dimir Control deck aims to outlast and outsmart the opponent in a slow, methodical manner.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck focuses on efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher, while also including disruptive spells like Duress and Cast Down to control the opponent's resources. The Orzhov colors provide a good balance between aggression and control, allowing the deck to adapt to different situations. The deck also includes some card advantage tools like Novice Inspector and Thorn of the Black Rose to maintain momentum throughout the game.

The focus of this deck is on maintaining control over the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells. The key strategy is to leverage card advantage and efficient threats like Gurmag Angler to outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour to dig for key pieces and maintain a strong hand. Lórien Revealed provides additional card draw and filtering, while Unexpected Fangs offers a versatile removal option. Overall, the deck aims to slowly grind out victories through careful resource management and strategic plays.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of gates as a mana base while utilizing a variety of spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and establish board presence with creatures like Outlaw Medic and Squadron Hawk. The inclusion of Prismatic Strands allows for protection against combat damage, ensuring the longevity of the player's creatures. The deck also includes specific gates and support cards to further enhance its control abilities.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the game through removal spells and creature interaction while generating value through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards. The deck utilizes a combination of cheap removal spells like Defile and Cast Down, along with creatures like Crypt Rats and Avenging Hunter to control the board. Additionally, the deck includes card draw options like Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute to maintain resources. The deck also includes various ways to gain life and recurring creatures to outvalue the opponent in the long game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Goblin Blast-Runner and Goblin Bushwhacker, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion help generate additional creatures and damage. With a low mana curve and a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a barrage of low-cost, aggressive red creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Reckless Lackey alongside burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to end the game swiftly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Galvanic Blast to provide additional reach and board presence. The key strategy is to maintain pressure and force the opponent on the defensive throughout the match.

This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through sacrificing creatures and gaining life. The deck includes removal spells like Cast Down and Defile, as well as creatures like Crypt Rats and Avenging Hunter to control the board. Cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering allow for sacrificing creatures for additional benefits. The deck also includes cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Troll of Khazad-dûm to provide card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a win through attrition.

This UR Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plays while controlling the board with counterspells and removals like Skred and Lightning Bolt. Augur of Bolas and Murmuring Mystic provide card advantage and token generation, while Tolarian Terror and Lórien Revealed offer additional control options. The deck also includes some creatures like Azure Fleet Admiral and Crimson Fleet Commodore for added pressure. The mana base consists of Snow-Covered Islands and Mountains, with a good mix of card draw and deck manipulation spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to ensure consistency in drawing key cards.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through removal spells and board wipes, while also generating value from sacrificing creatures and artifacts. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence by recurring creatures from the graveyard and generating card advantage through sacrificing artifacts. The use of cards like Avenging Hunter and Thorn of the Black Rose allows for additional card draw and maintaining control of the game. The deck also includes cards like Crypt Rats and Tithing Blade to deal with opponent's creatures and maintain board dominance.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing low cost creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Reckless Lackey, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Supporting spells like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion help to generate additional tokens and damage. Overall, the deck seeks to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining a steady stream of damage output.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by countering spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage through card draw and token generation. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently removing threats with burn spells and countermagic. Additionally, it utilizes snow-covered lands to power up Skred and Tolarian Terror for removal and provides dual color mana fixing with Volatile Fjord. Finally, the deck includes a mix of creatures and enchantments to apply pressure and generate card advantage.

The focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, powerful creatures like Reckless Lackey and Goblin Blast-Runner, while also utilizing direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Bushwhacker allow for explosive turns and quick wins, all while maintaining a consistent aggressive strategy. By emphasizing speed and efficiency, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to set up their defenses.

The main idea of this Aggro - Red Deck Wins Pauper format is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck focuses on low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Experimental Synthesizer and Kuldotha Rebirth provide early creature presence, while burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt offer direct damage to the opponent or removal for threats. With a combination of cheap creatures, direct damage spells, and aggressive tactics, this deck aims to outpace and outdamage the opponent to secure a swift victory.
